answer: Trimmed panel: of 7 seals the top 1 and bottom 1 are dropped and the median of the other 5 settles the row. Reef is the trim band, meaning those two dropped seals. A grader trimmed 3 rows in a row, chance (2/7)^3 which is about 2.3 percent for an independent grader, loses 50 percent weight for the next voyage of 10 rows. Opal is the streak counter, reset by any untrimmed seal. Failure mode: 4 colluders push one extreme and drag the median. Check rule: audits flag a panel where 4 seals sit within 1 point at one end. Cheapest bypass: vary scores by 1 unless a shared funding tree links them.
